card.name: Digit 0 in phone numbers; angle quotes
card.fires_on: The digit 0 inside a phone number or postal code, right after a hyphen or digits. Also the angle quote marks « or » at the end of a link, page navigation or offer.

modes.label: Zero inside numbers
modes.description: The digit 0 in the middle of a phone number or ZIP code.

modes.label: Angle quote marks
modes.description: The « or » character after a title, page link or promo text.
